elements.name: Collector
elements.doc: networkObservationCollector polls a network controller for asset, session, link, gateway, and traffic observations. It caches API tokens in Redis and publishes the observations to Kafka.

params.name: fileTokensPath
params.usage: directory of bootstrap token files, a mounted Secret volume

params.name: fileTokensReadOnly
params.usage: whether the bootstrap token files are read-only

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: maxWorkers
params.usage: concurrent console fetch workers, at least 1

params.name: normalizeHardwareAddress
params.usage: canonicalize hardware addresses in asset observations

params.name: retryMax
params.usage: max retries per controller HTTP request

elements.name: IdentityAnomalyDetector
elements.doc: identityAnomalyDetector consumes digital-twin changes, tracks identity-to-endpoint associations in Redis, and publishes an alert when a known identity appears from an unexpected endpoint.

params.name: handlersLimit
params.usage: goroutines handling assemblies concurrently; negative means unlimited, zero is not allowed

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: policyRuleName
params.usage: policy rule naming the generated alerts

elements.name: Journal
elements.doc: detectionAlertsJournal consumes security alerts, upserts them into PostgreSQL, and maintains views for a PostgREST facade.

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: postgresRoleName
params.usage: PostgreSQL role granted access to the journal views

elements.name: SyslogExporter
elements.doc: detectionSyslogExporter consumes security alerts, encodes them as syslog messages, and sends them to a configured SIEM endpoint.

params.name: format
params.usage: syslog format for the alerts, rfc5424 or rfc3164

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: protocol
params.usage: transport protocol for the syslog connection, udp or tcp

params.name: serverAddress
params.usage: host:port of the SIEM syslog server

params.name: timeout
params.usage: write timeout on the syslog connection

elements.name: GraphComponent
elements.doc: digitalTwinGraph applies mutation batches to the Neo4j-backed digital twin and publishes a digest of each completed change set.

params.name: applyLimit
params.usage: max compilations applied per batch, at most fetchLimit

params.name: batchTTL
params.usage: max wait before flushing a compilation batch

params.name: database
params.usage: name of the neo4j database to use

params.name: doAPOCParallel
params.usage: use APOC parallel processing for write pipelining

params.name: initialSnapshotTimeout
params.usage: max wait for the initial snapshot before processing compilations

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: neo4j
params.usage: URL of the backing neo4j server

params.name: receiveTimeout
params.usage: watchdog: shut down if no message arrives in time; zero disables

elements.name: TranslatorComponent
elements.doc: digitaltwin consumes canonical network observations and publishes graph mutation batches for the digital-twin graph.

params.name: assetObservedURL
params.usage: SQS queue URL for asset observations

params.name: assetsBehindGatewayStatusURL
params.usage: SQS queue URL for assets behind a gateway status

params.name: consumesAssetsBehindGateway
params.usage: topic of assets behind a gateway statuses

params.name: fetchLimit
params.usage: max messages fetched concurrently for dependency analysis

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: region
params.usage: AWS region for SQS queues; empty disables SQS

elements.name: Endpoint
elements.doc: a site-bound network coordinate such as the SIEM syslog server address

elements.name: Kafka
elements.doc: access to a Kafka cluster: sliced from the per-environment Strimzi operator or attached to an external broker

params.name: cluster
params.usage: substrate cluster to hold or verify the access on

elements.name: KafkaCluster
elements.doc: a Strimzi-managed Kafka cluster, named by the site (site-kafka-bootstrap in cloud, an edge broker on-prem)

elements.name: Neo4j
elements.doc: access to a Neo4j server for the digital twin of a target network's graph database

params.name: server
params.usage: Neo4j server to hold or verify the access on

elements.name: Neo4jServer
elements.doc: the Neo4j server backing the digital twin of a target network (bolt://twin-neo4j:7687 in the deployment bundle)

elements.name: Postgres
elements.doc: access to a named database on the PostgreSQL server

params.name: database
params.usage: database name the access is scoped to (for example "postgres")

params.name: server
params.usage: PostgreSQL server to hold or verify the access on

elements.name: PostgresServer
elements.doc: the PostgreSQL server behind the alerts journal and the PostgREST facade (postgresql:5432)

elements.name: Redis
elements.doc: an account on one logical database of the shared Redis server

params.name: db
params.usage: logical database number the access is scoped to

params.name: server
params.usage: Redis server to carve the database access from

elements.name: RedisServer
elements.doc: the shared Redis instance of the deployment (security-redis:6379 in the deployment bundle)

elements.name: Secret
elements.doc: an operator-supplied credential, delivered as a Kubernetes Secret key in the scenario deployment

elements.name: Component
elements.doc: observationTranslator consumes raw controller observations and publishes canonical asset, identity, session, route, and link events for the digital twin.

params.name: fetchLimit
params.usage: max messages fetched concurrently for dependency analysis

params.name: kafkaBrokers
params.usage: comma-separated Kafka bootstrap brokers (shared flag kafka-brokers, required)

params.name: kafkaConfig
params.usage: sarama configuration as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared flag kafka-config)

params.name: kafkaTopicOptions
params.usage: gocloud topic batcher options as ;-separated key=value pairs (shared env KAFKA_TOPIC_OPTIONS)
